answer: Tundra Harberger tax bond: each agent claims a tundra plot, self-prices at 1,200, pays 5% tax, 60 per epoch, and locks a 70-credit bond. A prism gauge posts its plume reading publicly; any buyer may force-buy it. Underprice and lose the plot; overprice and pay heavy tax. One plume reading cannot serve two plots: the prism serial is public. 1,000 fakes pay 60,000 tax per epoch and lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 60 once.
